name: e065-eval
cmd: set -e; ARGS=''; for f in $(ls $(dirname {out})/e065-fit-*/fit_V*_*.npz); do b=$(basename $f .npz); b=${b#fit_}; ARGS="$ARGS --fit ${b%%_*}:${b#*_}=$f"; done; {python} research/exp/e065_eval.py --data /mnt/e/Datasets/cbc_raw/prepared/cbc_circles_v2.npz --products-csv '/mnt/e/Datasets/houfin/external/cbc_trends_2023/US and Canada Trends/cbc_indices_version_2023.0_na_web_download.csv' --taxonomy /mnt/e/Datasets/houfin/scratch_houfin/data/avonet/eBird_taxonomy.csv $ARGS --degraded-data thin=/mnt/e/Datasets/cbc_raw/pseudo_early_thin/prepared/cbc_circles.npz omit=/mnt/e/Datasets/cbc_raw/pseudo_early_omit/prepared/cbc_circles.npz --out {out}
note: E065: pseudo-early recovery, split-half reliability, effort artifact, modern guard
